entities.name: Web3D Consortium
entities.note: Non-profit organization that develops and maintains the X3D standard.

entities.name: X3D 4.0
entities.note: The latest major version of the Extensible 3D Graphics standard, featuring close integration with HTML5 and glTF.

entities.name: Khronos Group
entities.note: An open consortium creating advanced interoperability standards for 3D graphics, VR, and AR.

entities.name: glTF
entities.note: A royalty-free specification for the efficient transmission and loading of 3D scenes and models.

entities.name: AOUSD
entities.note: Alliance for OpenUSD, an organization dedicated to fostering the standardization of Universal Scene Description.

entities.name: OpenUSD
entities.note: An open-source 3D scene description framework developed by Pixar.

entities.name: W3C
entities.note: The World Wide Web Consortium, the main international standards organization for the World Wide Web.

entities.name: WebXR
entities.note: A W3C API for accessing virtual reality and augmented reality devices in web browsers.

entities.name: WebGPU
entities.note: A modern web API providing low-level, high-performance access to GPU hardware.

entities.name: WebGL
entities.note: A JavaScript API for rendering interactive 2D and 3D graphics within any compatible web browser.

entities.name: OpenXR
entities.note: A royalty-free standard for access to virtual reality and augmented reality platforms and devices.

entities.name: OGC
entities.note: Open Geospatial Consortium, an international voluntary consensus standards organization.

entities.name: 3D Tiles
entities.note: An OGC standard designed for streaming and rendering massive 3D geospatial datasets.

entities.name: buildingSMART
entities.note: The worldwide industry body driving the digital transformation of the built asset industry.

entities.name: IFC
entities.note: Industry Foundation Classes, a standardized digital description of the built environment.

entities.name: three.js
entities.note: A popular cross-browser JavaScript library and API used to create and display animated 3D computer graphics.

entities.name: Babylon.js
entities.note: A real-time 3D engine using a JavaScript library for displaying 3D graphics in a web browser via HTML5.

entities.name: A-Frame
entities.note: An open-source web framework for building virtual reality experiences, based on HTML and three.js.

entities.name: PlayCanvas
entities.note: An open-source 3D game engine and interactive web application framework.

entities.name: Unreal Engine
entities.note: A highly advanced real-time 3D creation tool developed by Epic Games.

entities.name: Unity
entities.note: A cross-platform game engine developed by Unity Technologies.

entities.name: Blender
entities.note: A free and open-source 3D computer graphics software toolset.

entities.name: NVIDIA
entities.note: A multinational technology company that designs graphics processing units and related software.

entities.name: NVIDIA Omniverse
entities.note: A computing platform that enables individuals and teams to develop Universal Scene Description (OpenUSD) based 3D workflows.

entities.name: Cesium
entities.note: The company that created CesiumJS and the 3D Tiles format for 3D geospatial data.

entities.name: CesiumJS
entities.note: An open-source JavaScript library for world-class 3D globes and maps.

entities.name: X3DOM
entities.note: An open-source framework and runtime to integrate 3D content into HTML5 web pages.

entities.name: X_ITE
entities.note: A standard-compliant 3D JavaScript library for WebGL that renders X3D and VRML.

entities.name: Inline
entities.note: An X3D node that can load another 3D scene from a URL, which in X3D 4.0 explicitly supports glTF.

entities.name: CADGeometry
entities.note: An X3D component that provides nodes for Computer-Aided Design (CAD) assembly structures.

entities.name: GeoSpatial
entities.note: An X3D component that provides support for geographic and geospatial coordinates.

entities.name: VRML
entities.note: Virtual Reality Modeling Language, the predecessor to X3D.

entities.name: Castle Game Engine
entities.note: A cross-platform 3D and 2D game engine supporting X3D, VRML, and glTF formats.

entities.name: Blender X3D Exporter
entities.note: An add-on for Blender that allows users to export 3D models into the X3D format.
